limitations: The Newey–West lag order is not reported; lag 1 is a best-effort choice.
The paper does not report whether winsorization is pooled or grouped; this attempt uses annual 1/99 cutoffs.
The paper does not identify the adjusted or unadjusted I/B/E/S product; unadjusted Summary History/Actuals are used with relative CRSP share-factor alignment.
The paper does not name the SIC provider; the implementation uses Compustat historical SICH with date-effective CRSP DSENAMES SICCD only when SICH is missing or invalid.
The paper’s full all-tests-common sample is not verified because unassigned return-predictability controls and the future forecast-error test are not reconstructed.
The installed xtfmb lagged estimator reports average raw R-squared and diagonal HAC coefficient variances; adjusted R-squared and valid joint HAC tests are unavailable.
The Table 8 same-or-adjacent-month forecast boundary is a documented operational choice; the paper does not uniquely define its calendar cutoff.
